releases.name: graphify-opencode 1.1.1
releases.body:
## What changed
- Adds corrected OpenCode v2 support for the hosted Graphify MCP server and /graphify command.
- Registers /graphify independently of MCP reconciliation and forwards command arguments, attachments, and delivery through the OpenCode v2 session API.
- Preserves the existing OpenCode v1 server entrypoint and hosted MCP OAuth flow.

## Validation
- 17 unit tests pass.
- npm run check passes.
- npm pack --dry-run includes the expected package files.
- Published to npm as graphify-opencode@1.1.1.
